name: @checkly-templates/checkly-runner
description: Standalone, self-contained Checkly project that consumes the template kinds as libraries. Owns its own checkly.config.ts + checks.json so `npx checkly test` runs the checks ad-hoc (no monitors deployed) directly from this folder.
//workspaceDeps: The @checkly-templates/* workspace packages are intentionally not listed here. They resolve via npm-workspace hoisting at the repo root. Listing them would make Checkly's cloud runner try to `npm install` them from the public registry and 404, since they're unpublished.
